messages:
alex.dev: quick check — final cutoff in ~3h. Is everyone set for the canary? I pushed branch release/canary with v2.10.0-b4 and opened the rollout PR.
maya.pm: thanks — saw the PR. changelog has one missing line for the header tweak, left a comment on the PR.
sam.sre: CI is tripping on tests/test_token_cache.py::test_kv_eviction on ubuntu-latest. Failure looks like a timeout / race. investigating.
ci-bot: [build #4521] pipeline started for ref release/canary (commit 9f3d2a).
ci-bot: [build #4521] unit-tests: 45 passed, 1 failed — tests/test_token_cache.py::test_kv_eviction (flaky).
sam.sre: local reproduce command: `pytest tests/test_token_cache.py::test_kv_eviction -q -k linux` — timing-sensitive assertion fails ~1/3 runs.
rafa.engineer: I ran into a similar flake earlier. I have a small test-fixture tweak (add a short retry/sleep) that stabilizes on my machine. Will push a patch in a minute.
jen.releases: heads-up — if the flaky test blocks the canary for >15m we should abort and cut RC from main. Can we get an ETA on the fix?
rafa.engineer: PR in 4m: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/794 — fixture change only, adds `time.sleep(0.03)` and extra wait-for-file guard.
alex.dev: if that fixes CI, plan is: tag v2.10.0-rc1 and start the canary rollout. If not, cancel canary and cut rc off main.
maya.pm: also reminder to include the API header note in the changelog entry (one-liner). I can add it if you prefer.
sam.sre: re-run results on my laptop after rafa's change: 10/10 passes. Kicking CI rerun now.
ci-bot: [build #4522] rerun triggered by rafa.engineer.
ci-bot: [build #4522] all checks passed ✅ — unit-tests, integration, e2e.
jen.releases: nice. alex — please bump package.json version and add the changelog line: "runtime: token cache race fix" before tagging.
alex.dev: done — bumped to 2.10.0-rc1 in package.json and CHANGELOG.md. Tag pushed: `git tag v2.10.0-rc1 && git push origin v2.10.0-rc1`.
maya.pm: changelog entry confirmed. moving cutoff reminder to done. thanks y'all :tada:
jen.releases: marking this thread resolved for release ops. I'll follow up with rollout metrics and any post-canary regressions in #eng-monitoring tomorrow.
